Marks the section the Arrangement loop repeats. Drag an edge to move the start or end, or drag the bar to move the loop without changing its length.

Idea - In Ableton, be able to quickly set the loop start and end braces to the start and end markers
Idea - In Ableton, be able to quickly set the loop start and end braces to the start and end markers

For some absurd reason, Ableton assumes that we always want to "quantize" loop braces to a warp marker defined at a specific BPM or to a specific bar line in the . The only alternative is to choose "Fixed Grid" as "Off" and then zoom in to an absurdly small interval to ensure that they match. This could easily be achieved with Max for Live.
Idea - In Ableton, be able to quickly set the loop start and end braces to the start and end markers
